{"reason": "Added a monitor branch: medium/high risk with inventory-days >= 9 goes to monitor, since regular deliveries (lead <= 8 in failure rows) arrive first, turning 45000 supplier switches on healthy stock (inv 10-13.2 rows) free. Raised expedite threshold 5->9: high-risk short horizons get the always-on-time 35000 alert instead of pricier, sometimes-late alternatives.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 9))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (>= inventory-days 9))
     (list 'monitor))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
